verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.dev.runwayml.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and a second llms.txt exists at runway.com/llms.txt. The dev llms.txt carries agent-oriented content: the task-polling flow, a pointer to the machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec (also probe-verified), and a map of product areas. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs effectively.
